BiblicalUsage: Jekoljah is Jecholiah, an Israelitess, the mother of Azariah king of Judah. In 2 Kings 15:2, his mother's name was Jecholiah of Jerusalem. The fuller story is told on the Jecholiah, Mother of Azariah profile in Biblical People.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Jecholiah shows me God keeps His promises across generations, even through flawed families.
